description.p: Computer Modern Unicode fonts, converted from METAFONT sources using mftrace with autotrace backend and fontforge. Some characters in several fonts are copied from Blue Sky type 1 fonts released by AMS. Currently the fonts contain glyphs from Latin (METAFONT ec, tc, vnr), Cyrillic (lh), Greek (cbgreek when available) code sets and IPA extensions (from tipa). This font set contains 33 fonts.
